hunks.baseline: Chulwoo was a massive man, large enough to make the seat look cramped.
hunks.sol: It was Chulwoo, a massive man whose bulk made the seat itself look cramped.

hunks.baseline: “Why? You don’t like it?”
hunks.sol: “Why? Don’t like it?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t like it either. That’s why I said it. Guess we agree on something.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t like it either. That’s why I asked. Looks like we agree.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t say disgusting things!”
hunks.sol: “Don’t say something so disgusting!”

hunks.baseline: “Lots of people besides you would love to sit there. Switch with anyone standing down below.”
hunks.sol: “Plenty of people would love to sit there. Pick anyone standing down below and trade with them.”

hunks.baseline: “Did you just insult my parents? Are you trying to pull a Jin-rula in the Jin Family of Taiyuan?”
hunks.sol: “Did you just insult my parents? In the Jin Family of Taiyuan? Are you trying to pull a Jin-rula here?”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo’s body trembled as Baek Museong scolded him.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo trembled with rage, but Baek Museong immediately rebuked him.

hunks.baseline: “You! What kind of outrageous nonsense is this?”
hunks.sol: “You fool! What kind of outrageous language is that?”

hunks.baseline: “No, Senior Brother. It’s just…”
hunks.sol: “No, Senior Brother, I…”

hunks.baseline: “Quiet. Young Hero Jin, I apologize in place of my Junior Brother. I also apologize to Martial Uncle Cheongpung.”
hunks.sol: “Quiet. Young Hero Jin, I apologize on behalf of my Junior Brother. I also offer my apologies to Martial Uncle Cheongpung.”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung, who had been hiding behind me, cautiously peeked his head out.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung, who had been hiding behind me, cautiously poked his head out.

hunks.baseline: I also smiled gently.
hunks.sol: I smiled gently as well.

hunks.baseline: “I’m fine too. Aren’t you at the age when your blood is running hot? We have to be understanding.”
hunks.sol: “I’m fine too. His blood is bound to run hot at that age. We should be understanding.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re five years younger than me, you little punk. What did you just say?”
hunks.sol: “You’re five years younger than me, you little punk! What did you just say?”

hunks.baseline: “Young Hero Baek, if you don’t mind, could you switch seats with me? I’m a little afraid to sit next to him…”
hunks.sol: “Young Hero Baek, if it isn’t too much trouble, could you switch seats with me? I’m a little afraid to sit beside him…”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo on my right, Cheongpung on my left.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo to my right, Cheongpung to my left.

hunks.baseline: No matter how much I looked around, I couldn’t see Jin Wikyung or Wipeng.
hunks.sol: I looked around, but there was no sign of Jin Wikyung or Wipeng.

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of the Jin Family surrounding the Grand Training Ground began striking their weapons.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family martial artists surrounding the Grand Training Ground began striking their weapons against the ground.

hunks.baseline: There were more than three hundred of them, and from their ranks surged an aura sharp as a blade and a spirit as powerful as a wave.
hunks.sol: There were more than three hundred of them. A blade-sharp aura and wave-like spirit surged from their ranks.

hunks.baseline: The sound resembled the drums of a battlefield. It grew louder and louder until it swallowed every other noise.
hunks.sol: Like drums pounding across a battlefield, the sound grew louder and louder until it swallowed every other noise.

hunks.baseline: And then…
hunks.sol: And then—

hunks.baseline: With a thunderous crash louder than any before it, the human curtain split apart.
hunks.sol: With the loudest thunderclap yet, the human curtain split apart.
